title: Fix config editor crash when exemplar destinations aren't a list
summary: If a Prometheus data source was set up from a config file with a single exemplar link instead of a list, Grafana's settings page crashed and couldn't be opened. Now the bad value is safely ignored and a warning explains what's wrong, so the page always loads.

title: Fix query editor crash when the cache overlap window is a number
summary: Writing the query cache overlap window as a plain number (say 600) instead of text like "10m" made the Prometheus query editor crash. Grafana now falls back to the 10-minute default, just like it does for any other invalid value.

title: Make AI-generated Grafana links work with plain dates
summary: Grafana's MCP server lets AI assistants open dashboards and grab panel images. When the assistant asked for a time range like "2026-04-28", the link could jump to 1970. Those dates are now converted correctly, so links open on the day you asked for.
